Kodun tamamı (Python + numpy):

import numpy as np
n = 300
x = np.random.rand(n) * 10
y = np.random.rand(n) * 4 + 4
vx = np.random.randn(n) * 3
vy = np.zeros(n)
for adim in range(1800):
    vy -= 9.8 / 60
    x += vx / 60
    y += vy / 60
    vy[y < 0] *= -0.9
    y[y < 0] = 0
    vx[(x < 0) | (x > 10)] *= -1
